# Nexy

> Fullstack Python meta-framework: FastAPI and Starlette on the server, Vite on the client. A route
> is a file under `src/routes/`.

Nexy is meant to be read without a browser and without a build step. Start with the documentation
index, follow the page for the task, and trust the source when the two disagree.

## Documentation

- [Index](docs/README.md): every page, one line each
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started/quick-start.md): create a project, run it, build it
- [How Nexy works](docs/getting-started/how-nexy-works.md): who builds what, and one request
- [Project structure](docs/getting-started/project-structure.md): files, folders, generated output
- [Routing](docs/routing/README.md): file path to URL, groups, reserved names
- [Pages](docs/routing/fbr/pages/README.md): dynamic segments, catch-all, layouts, error pages
- [Hooks](docs/routing/fbr/navigation/hooks.md): request path, query, cookies, session, TOC from a page
- [Modular routing](docs/routing/modular/README.md): controllers, modules, injection
- [SSR](docs/rendering/ssr.md): server rendering, the default
- [CSR](docs/rendering/csr.md): client-side rendering
- [ISR](docs/rendering/isr.md): `revalidate` and stale-while-revalidate
- [WebSocket](docs/routing/fbr/realtime/websocket.md): `SOCKET` handlers
- [Views](docs/views/README.md): which view format to use
- [.nexy files](docs/views/nexy/README.md): frontmatter, properties, Jinja2, components
- [Markdown and MDX](docs/views/nexy/markdown.md): `.md` content, `.mdx` components
- [Components](docs/views/nexy/components.md): `Image`, `Link`, `Audio`, `Video`, `Import`
- [React](docs/views/react/README.md), [Vue](docs/views/vue.md), [Svelte](docs/views/svelte.md),
  [Solid](docs/views/solid.md), [Preact](docs/views/preact.md)
- [API](docs/routing/fbr/handlers/README.md): Python handlers, parameters, responses
- [Actions](docs/guides/actions.md): `@Action` POST endpoints with generated paths
- [Frontend](docs/guides/frontend.md): Vite, dev server, build, styling
- [CLI](docs/reference/cli.md): commands and flags
- [Testing](docs/guides/testing.md): `nx test`, `TestClient`, vitest, CI
- [Config](docs/reference/config.md): every `nexyconfig.py` field and its default
- [Python API](docs/reference/python-api.md): every exported name, by module
- [Glossary](docs/reference/glossary.md): the words these docs use
- [i18n](docs/guides/i18n.md): internationalization is up to your application
- [Deploy](docs/deployment/README.md): build output, Docker, reverse proxy
- [For AI agents](docs/reference/agents.md): invariants and verification commands
- [Coding agents](docs/guides/ai-agents.md): skills, `AGENTS.md` and `nx skills`
- [Troubleshooting](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): first problems and their fix
- [Recipes](docs/guides/recipes.md): sign in, a JSON API, file upload; the code is tested
- [Upgrading to 2.2](docs/getting-started/upgrading.md): what changes for an existing project

## Source

- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): request lifecycle, compiler pipeline, package layout
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development workflow and quality gates
- `nexy/core/config.py`: option defaults
- `nexy/modules/routers/fbrouter/`: routing implementation
- `nexy/modules/compiler/`: `.nexy` and Markdown compilation
